Partner with Stock Administration, Legal, Global Mobility, and external tax advisers where cross-border tax treatment or specialist advice is required, and ensure timely payroll reporting and reconciliation. Support and monitor integrations and data flows between ADP Celergo, in-country payroll vendors, the general ledger, Workday HR, and benefits platforms, ensuring data integrity across multiple currencies, languages, and statutory calendars and escalating interface failures promptly. Manage payroll queries and escalations through the agreed case-management process, ensuring responses are accurate, appropriately documented, and delivered within established service-level expectations. Draft clear employee communications regarding payroll corrections, overpayments, underpayments, tax adjustments, and country-specific payroll matters, obtaining appropriate review for sensitive or material communications. Compliance, Tax & Risk Management Maintain strong international payroll knowledge, with direct operational expertise in several of the covered countries and the ability to develop knowledge of additional jurisdictions through collaboration with in-country providers and specialist advisers. Proactively identify legislative or regulatory updates and coordinate required operational changes. Manage day-to-day multi-country payroll tax compliance activities across EMEA and APAC, including registrations, statutory filings, payment requirements, and routine correspondence with tax and social security authorities such as HMRC, ZUS and the Polish Tax Office, Skatteetaten, the Agencia Tributaria and Seguridad Social, Skatteverket, and Singapore's IRAS/CPF Board. Escalate material assessments, disputes, penalties, or compliance risks to the Global Payroll Manager. Support the Global Payroll Manager, Legal, Finance, Tax, and HR with new-country payroll assessments, registrations, implementation activities, documentation, testing, and operational readiness. Legal, tax, permanent-establishment, and employment-law determinations must be validated by the appropriate internal or external specialists. Maintain complete payroll control evidence, approval records, reconciliations, issue logs, and audit trails for every payroll cycle in accordance with company record-retention requirements.
